description: This file defines the ParamsMiddleware class, which handles parameter extraction, user authentication, and error handling for API requests within the Api\V8\Middleware namespace.

classes.name: ParamsMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for processing request parameters, setting current user context, and handling errors in API requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing ParamsMiddleware with BaseParam and BeanManager instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the middleware invocation, setting user context, configuring parameters, and error handling.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the current user globally based on OAuth2 token from the request.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Extracts and merges route, query, and body parameters from the request.
